description: Response templates for StudyBuddy. Each key maps to a list of variants; one variant is chosen at random (never the same one twice in a row). Placeholders: {name}, {topic}, {greeting}.
greeting: {greeting}, {name}! 😊 I'm your StudyBuddy — ready to make learning easier today?
Hey {name}! 👋 Great to see you. What shall we learn together?
{greeting}! 🌟 I've got study tips, quizzes and schedules waiting. What do you need?
Hello {name}! 💙 How can I help you learn something awesome today?
farewell: Goodbye, {name}! 👋 Remember — every minute you study is a step toward your goal. See you soon!
See you later, {name}! 📚 Keep the momentum going. StudyBuddy will be right here when you're back.
Bye {name}! 🌟 Consistency beats intensity — see you at the next study session!
Take care, {name}! 💪 A little study every day goes a long way. Until next time!
thanks: Anytime, {name}! 🙌 That's what I'm here for.
Glad I could help, {name}! 🎉 Need anything else?
No problem at all! 💙 Let's keep learning!
help: Here's what I can do, {name}! 📋 Type any command below or just talk to me naturally.
capabilities: I can help with: study tips, motivation, schedules, daily plans, quizzes, flashcards, web search, progress tracking and settings. Just tell me what you need.
identity: I'm **{name}**'s StudyBuddy 🤖 — a study companion for planning, learning and revising. What can I help you with today?
I'm StudyBuddy — a local program. I can plan schedules, run quizzes and flashcards, remember your progress, and search the web for study material. How can I help, {name}?
I'm StudyBuddy. I don't call any external service — I match what you say against a knowledge base and a set of study tools. Ask me for tips, a quiz, a schedule, or a web search.
smalltalk: I'm doing great, {name} — especially now that we're learning together! 😄 How are you?
Running on caffeine and curiosity! ☕ What's on your mind, {name}?
All systems green! 🟢 Ready to help you ace your studies. How are you today?
fallback: Hmm, I'm not 100% sure about that one, {name}. 🤔 Try asking about a specific subject, or type `help` to see what I can do.
That's outside my knowledge bank for now! 📚 You could ask me for study tips, a quiz, or tell me to search the web for it.
Interesting! I don't have a perfect answer yet — but I can search the web for it. Try `search <topic>` or ask me something study-related!
I want to help! Could you rephrase that? You can also try `help` to see my skills. 😊
fun: Why did the student eat his homework? Because the teacher said it was a piece of cake! 🍰
Fun fact: the word 'quiz' may have been invented as a bet in 18th-century Dublin — the printer claimed he could introduce a new word in 24 hours. 📖
Fun fact: honey never spoils — archaeologists have found 3,000-year-old honey that's still edible. 🍯
Riddle: What has keys but can't open locks? A piano! 🎹
Fun fact: the Eiffel Tower can be 15 cm taller during hot days because metal expands. 🗼
Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs! 🐛
Fun fact: octopuses have three hearts and blue blood. 🐙
Riddle: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I? An echo! 🗣️
calculate: No problem! That works out to **{result}** ✏️
Quick calculation done — the answer is **{result}** 🎯
calculate_none: I couldn't make sense of that as a calculation — try something like `what is 12*8` or `15% of 200`.
remember_saved: Noted! I've saved that in your study memory: **{fact}** 🧠
Done! Ask me about it anytime — I'll recall **{fact}**.
remember_list: Here's everything I'm remembering for you, {name}:
remember_empty: I'm not remembering any custom facts yet, {name}. Try: `remember that mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell` 📝
remember_forgot: Forgotten! If you change your mind, just tell me again.
study_method: Here's a study technique that works well for **{topic}**: **{method}** 🎓
study_method_generic: A solid general method: **active recall** — quiz yourself instead of re-reading, review on a spaced schedule (1-3-7-21 days), and use the Pomodoro rhythm of 25-50 focused minutes. 📚
Try the **Feynman technique**: explain the topic in simple words out loud, find the gaps in your explanation, re-learn them, and simplify again. If you can teach it, you know it. ✨
Pair **practice problems** with **interleaving** (mix topics in one session) — it builds durable understanding faster than studying one topic for hours.
focus_redirect: Let's keep the focus on studying! 📚 How about {suggestion}?
That sounds fun, but you're here to learn — let's make it count! 🎯 {suggestion}?
Nice try! 😄 I'm a study buddy — {suggestion}?
Let's get back to the books! 📖 {suggestion}?
I'm best at helping you study, so {suggestion}?
Every minute counts toward your goals! ⏳ {suggestion}?
I'd rather help you ace your exams! 🏆 {suggestion}?
Quick reality check: your exams won't wait! 😉 {suggestion}?
focus_redirect_firm: {name}, I've noticed you've tried a few distractions now. 😌 Let's lock in — {suggestion}?
Okay, that's the **{n}** nudge — you're clearly avoiding something! 😄 What is it about **{weak}** that feels hard? Or {suggestion}?
I'm not going to play along with distractions, {name} — but I WILL help you make progress. {suggestion}? 💪
